name: MessageCard
description: A card component optimized for displaying messages with metadata. Combines an image, heading, paragraph text, and a call-to-action button in a structured layout.

notes: The root element uses role='article' to communicate a self-contained content block.
The image has an empty alt attribute when it is decorative — provide meaningful alt text via the image prop if the image conveys information.
The button is keyboard accessible with Enter and Space activation.
Focus indicator uses var(--color-border-focus) on the button element.

image.description: URL for the card image displayed at the top.

paragraph.description: Body paragraph text for the message.

buttonLabel.description: Label for the call-to-action button. When omitted, the button is not rendered.

onClick.description: Click handler for the call-to-action button.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element.

do: Provide a heading and paragraph for every MessageCard.
Use buttonLabel and onClick together for actionable messages.
Use meaningful image URLs or omit the image prop for text-only messages.
Keep paragraph text concise for scannability.
dont: Do not use MessageCard for complex form layouts — use Card with form components instead.
Do not nest interactive elements inside the heading or paragraph slots.
Do not use MessageCard for navigation — use a clickable Card with href instead.
